title: Alif-lam: shamsiyyah and qamariyyah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 4 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Alif-lam rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 4. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: The definite article ٱلْ
points: Sun: laam silent, shaddah on the next letter
Moon: laam with sukoon, said clearly

panels.title: Memory phrase
points: Moon letters: اِبْغِ حَجَّكَ وَخَفْ عَقِيمَهُ
All the others are sun letters
Check by sight: shaddah after the laam means sun

panels.title: The laam in the Name Allah

keywords.def: sun letter: the laam of al- is silent and the next letter doubles
moon letter: the laam of al- is said with a sukoon

questions.a: Both moon letters (م): the laam is said: al-mafarr, al-mustaqarr.

questions.q: Moon letters are in the phrase ...
Sort (pupil PDF): label every al- in 75:1 to 15 as sun or moon. Today's rota group recites 75:1 to 10.
questions.a: Sun: ٱلنَّفْسِ، ٱللَّوَّامَةِ، ٱلشَّمْسُ; moon: ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ، ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ، ٱلْبَصَرُ، ٱلْقَمَرُ، ٱلْمَفَرُّ، ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ.

questions.q: Extend: how many sun and moon letters are there?
Stretch: why is «ٱللَّوَّامَةِ» a sun letter even though it starts with laam?
questions.a: The laam of al- merges into the laam after it: laam is one of the 14 sun letters.
A) silent (sun letter). ن is a sun letter: the laam is silent and the ن doubles.

questions.q: Think again: Why do you think Arabic merges the laam into some letters but not others?
questions.a: The 14 sun letters come from near the laam's place in the mouth, so it merges for ease; the moon letters are far, so the laam stays clear.
